question: When and with what central inscription must the diagram be prepared?
premises: The diagram must be drawn on the previous day.
The yam-syllable is placed in the middle.
It is accompanied by its seed-syllable.
inference: On the previous day the practitioner must draw the diagram with the yam-syllable and its seed-syllable in the middle.
plain_english: On the previous day the diagram should be drawn, with the yam-syllable and its seed-syllable in the middle.
